name: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) — also called 2FA, two-factor or two-step verification, OTP/TOTP, authenticator app, hardware security key, FIDO2/WebAuthn, or passkey — a control requiring a second proof beyond a password before access is granted. Applied at login to identity providers and privileged interfaces. The place to look for MFA, 2FA, step-up authentication, or the second-factor requirement that blunts credential theft and phishing.
